approvalMode: {agent} is now in {mode, select, auto {auto} other {manual}} mode, from {surface, select, telegram {Telegram} console {the console} mini {the Mini App} cli {the CLI} other {binference}}
locked: 🔴 binference restarted and is locked. Run `binference unlock`.
unknownTx: ⚠️ {wallet}'s nonce {nonce} was used by a transaction binference did not sign
fillDiffers: ⚠️ A trade settled more than 1% away from its simulation. Check the trade.
fillUnknown: ⚠️ A trade settled, but no RPC can say what it received any more. Add a tracing RPC to the config and restart binference to finish it.
notSigned: ⚠️ A trade was cancelled before its first transaction was signed. Nothing was sent.
stepUnsent: ⚠️ A trade stopped part way: an earlier step landed on chain, but a later one was never signed. Check the wallet.
stepDropped: ⚠️ A trade was stuck and did not go through. Nothing moved, and the wallet is free again.
stepDroppedPartWay: ⚠️ A trade stopped part way: an earlier step landed on chain, but a later one was stuck and did not go through. The wallet is free again. Check the wallet.
rescueAddress: ⚠️ Rescue address changes to {address} at {when}. Not you? Cancel now.
lowGas: ⚠️ {wallet} has {balance} left for network fees. Add BNB.
sendLevelCancelled: Send level change to {to} cancelled; it stays {level}
ceilingOutdated: ⚠️ The wallets' ceilings still let sends pay {address}. Run `binference rescue set` with the owner key to update them.
